verdict.rationale: Granola's docs say it supports multiple languages for both transcription and generated summaries: 31 languages on desktop and 17 on mobile. The evidence never addresses switching languages mid-meeting, so only part of the story is documented. Missing for 10: documented handling of language switching within a meeting, a list of supported languages or accuracy detail, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can run meetings in languages other than English — transcription and summaries support many languages and handle language switching

citations.quote: Granola supports multiple languages for transcription and generated meeting summaries.
Granola supports 31 languages on desktop (macOS and Windows) and 17 languages on mobile (iOS and Android).
